homeLeavingBaseline.citation: Where leaving a parent's home starts for an adult of eighteen with nothing else pulling: well below staying, so it takes age, room and means to tip it. Calibrated against the ACS 2024 share of 18 to 34 year olds living with a parent (table B09021: about 57 percent at 18 to 24 and 17 percent at 25 to 34) in src/core2/home-leaving.test.ts.

homeLeavingAgeWeight.citation: How much each year of age past eighteen adds to the pull to leave a parent's home. The share living with a parent falls from about 57 percent at 18 to 24 to 17 percent at 25 to 34 (ACS 2024 B09021); the size is a starting value.

homeLeavingMeansWeight.citation: How much each multiple of the rent their own pay covers (up to the cap) adds to the pull to leave: someone whose pay covers a home easily is freer to go. A starting value.

homeLeavingMeansCap.citation: The multiple of the rent past which more pay adds nothing to the pull to leave. A starting value.

homeLeavingCrowdingWeight.citation: How much each person in the household beyond two adds to the pull to leave: a crowded home pushes people out. A starting value.

homeLeavingKinHold.citation: How much closeness to the parent they live with holds a person at home (closeness is zero to one). A starting value.

homeLeavingRentHold.citation: How much the share of their own pay that rent would take holds a person at home (up to the whole of it). A starting value.
